name: 01-worker-home
note: Worker can start a visit without an assignment. Supplied site photo and current work remain available.

name: 02-site-service
note: Site and service selection, optional crew disclosure and nearest-site suggestion.

name: 03-prepared-visit
note: Short service cards and before-photo/start actions.

name: 04-direct-camera
note: Direct camera capture with keep and retake; synthetic camera feed.

name: 05-snow-measurement
note: Ruler photo, manual inches and explicit confirmation. Automatic reading is optional.

name: 06-reading-fallback
note: Unavailable automatic reader leaves manual input usable and does not confirm a reading.

name: 07-issue-report
note: Category, urgency and description use the established issue form.

name: 08-company-review
note: Company reviews line/sub-line quantities and original versus claimed hours.

name: 09-private-photo
note: Same private viewing file available to the company; original retained separately.

name: 10-npi-catalogue
note: Contract line and sub-line configuration remains in NPI administration.

name: 11-sub-line-configuration
note: Parent line sets contract, service category and unit. Snow minimum/maximum bounds are explicit.

name: 12-notification-settings
note: Separate recipient list, escalation and daily-summary control.

name: 13-npi-verification
note: Exact claimed hours or reasoned correction; approval still follows company review.
